Client.Failures: Both title client tests fail with KeyNotFoundException at the new retitled reserialization assertion.

Findings.Title: Dialog retention assertion hashes an unrelated file
Findings.Evidence: The test creates retained-dialog.yaml directly under ReviewCache and hashes it, but never supplies that path to Write-ReplFailsafe, Find-ReplFailsafeByFingerprint, or a queued receipt. Real appendDialog recovery uses those helpers at repl-invoke.ps1:2543-2556. Therefore the tested file is not established as the workflow recovery payload.
Findings.Impact: The test can pass even if actual dialog recovery data is deleted or replaced, because the orphan file is untouched by the workflow.
Findings.Remedy: First queue the same dialog using the real handler and failsafe writer in a test-isolated failsafe directory. Capture the queued receipt failsafePath and its hash, seed stale success, then retry with Success=true and empty Output. Require rejection/current identity, non-success, and unchanged bytes at that exact actual recovery path. Restore any modified environment in finally.
